title: Building an old-school Might & Magic-style RPG in Godot using Astra AI
author: mrray87
selftext:
I'm building an old-school Might & Magic-style RPG in Godot, using Astra AI heavily throughout the development process — coding, prototyping, assets and iteration.

Astra seems to be better than less powerful models when it comes to 3D modelling, but it's still a diamond in the rough. Takes multiple iterations to get the geometry right anyways. They oversell the power, unless you are looking for something more or less standard, I feel. But it's still good, although eats through the weekly limit very quickly.

The trailer is also generated. But please feel free to be harsh.
